snippet.title: Pyrotoad (Precision Puzzle Platformer for Game Boy Color) Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
STEAM RELEASE NOV 3rd 2025!!

Please wishlist on steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3984130/Pyrotoad

Free demo on Itch!
https://rikoclon.itch.io/pyrotoad

Pyrotoad is an action platformer where you leap, shoot, and puzzle your way through 35 challenging stages. Harness flame powers, unlock new moves, and battle through diverse biomes in your quest to reclaim Pyrotoad’s stolen sunglasses!

A NEW GAME FOR GAME BOY COLOR!
MADE WITH GB STUDIO!

Pyrotoad is a puzzle-action precision platformer where you take on the role of Pyrotoad, a fiery frog with the enigmatic power to spew flames after chomping down fireflies. His mission? To reclaim his stolen sunglasses in an epic, hazard-filled quest.

Leap, shoot, and puzzle your way through 35 challenging stages across 10 diverse biomes, such as the regal halls of Webloch Castle, the fiery furnaces of Embercoat Factory, and the haunted Willowisp Woods. Along the way, unlock powerful abilities like double-jumping, wall-jumping, mid-air dashing, and more to outwit traps and overcome deadly obstacles.

The difficulty ramps up as you advance, putting even seasoned players to the test. Thankfully, most stages include checkpoints, and with the built-in password system, you can always pause your journey and return later.

So, do you have what it takes to master the flames and help Pyrotoad reclaim his shades?

Made by Jonny Manjiro and Rik Oclon
